projects.title: Console Calculator
projects.objective: Build a menu-driven calculator that performs standard arithmetic operations.
projects.curriculum: Variables, operators, conditionals, loops, functions and error handling

projects.title: Student Grade Management
projects.objective: Store student marks and produce results.
projects.curriculum: Structures, arrays, vectors, functions, conditionals and strings

projects.title: Number and Math Toolkit
projects.objective: Build a collection of reusable mathematical utilities.
projects.curriculum: Loops, functions, recursion, numeric types and algorithms

projects.title: Personal Expense Tracker
projects.objective: Record and summarize expenses in a local application.
features: Save and load records from a text file
projects.curriculum: Classes, vectors, file handling, strings and error handling

projects.title: Inventory and Billing System
projects.objective: Manage products and generate itemized bills.
projects.curriculum: Classes, maps, vectors, algorithms, file handling, validation and testing

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.curriculum: Object-oriented design, composition, containers, dates, error handling and architecture

projects.title: Data Analysis Tool
projects.objective: Process structured files and summarize their contents.
projects.curriculum: File streams, strings, algorithms, ranges, maps, lambdas and complexity analysis

projects.title: Command-Line Task Manager
features: Create, edit, complete and delete tasks
projects.curriculum: Classes, enums, containers, sorting, filesystem, error handling and automated tests

projects.title: Multithreaded File Indexer
projects.objective: Build a tool that searches and indexes files concurrently.
projects.curriculum: Filesystem, strings, hash maps, concurrency, synchronization, profiling and testing

projects.title: Generic Data-Structures Library
projects.objective: Create reusable implementations of selected data structures.
projects.curriculum: Class templates, concepts, iterators, move semantics, RAII, exception safety and CMake

projects.title: Networked Client-Server Application
projects.objective: Develop a small application in which clients communicate with a server.
projects.curriculum: Networking APIs/libraries, serialization, concurrency, resource ownership and security

projects.title: 2D Game Prototype
projects.objective: Build a playable game using a suitable graphics library or game engine.
projects.curriculum: Classes, composition, vectors, algorithms, state modeling, performance and build tooling

projects.title: Modular C++ Inventory and Order Platform
projects.objective: Develop a maintainable, tested C++ application that manages products, stock, customers and orders.
features: Itemized totals, discounts and basic tax calculations
Persistence with a defined format or database library
Error handling for missing records and failed storage
Logging, validation and repeatable release build
projects.curriculum: Functions, classes, RAII, standard containers, algorithms, templates where justified, persistence, exception safety, testing, Git, CMake, static analysis and release practices
